physicalContract: One narrow flexible navy collar follows the neck under the outer fur with consistent thickness.
One small gold bell hangs from the anatomical front center on a short loop under gravity.
Profiles keep the bell at the front silhouette; the strict back view hides the bell and shows only the nape band.
No rigid ring, side migration, floating, duplication, or body penetration.

generation.designBoard: Eight-view shadowless orthographic turnaround of the same seated NAVA cat with one soft navy collar and centered gold bell.

views.front: Strict front; bell hangs at exact chest center.
views.left: Cat faces viewer left; bell remains at the front silhouette beneath the chin.
views.back: Strict back; bell is hidden and only the nape band is visible.
views.right: Cat faces viewer right; bell remains at the front silhouette beneath the chin.
